sections.title: What is a Basis?
lecture_lines: Linearly independent vectors spanning a space.
Coordinates are coefficients of basis vectors.
animations: Appear: A basis is a set of vectors that span a space.
Highlight: Any vector can be written as a linear combination of basis vectors.
Scale up: Basis vectors are linearly independent.
Fade in: Introduce the first basis vector.
Fade in: Introduce the second basis vector.

sections.title: Why Change Basis?
animations: Appear: Changing basis simplifies vector representation.
Highlight: New basis may align better with problem.
Scale up: This can make calculations easier.
Fade in: Show a vector in the original basis.
Fade in: Show the same vector in a new basis.

sections.title: The Transition Matrix: The Bridge
lecture_lines: Use a transition matrix to change bases.
Columns are old basis vectors in new basis.
animations: Appear: The transition matrix connects two bases.
Highlight: It allows conversion from one basis to another.
Scale up: It's formed by the new basis vectors in old coordinates.
Fade in: Show the original basis vectors.
Fade in: Show the new basis vectors and the transition matrix.
